# Duaer

> The Duaer skill catalog lists call skills you can paste into an agent. Opening the catalog does not search and does not use credits.

Chinese index: [llms.txt](https://skills.duaer.com/zh/llms.txt).

## Skills

- [Search papers in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/papers.md): In Duaer, search published papers. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search proteins in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/proteins.md): In Duaer, search genes and proteins. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search clinical trials in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/trials.md): In Duaer, search clinical trials. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search compounds in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/compounds.md): In Duaer, search compounds and drugs. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search protein structures in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/structures.md): In Duaer, search protein structures. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search diseases in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/diseases.md): In Duaer, search UniProt disease names. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search organisms in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/organisms.md): In Duaer, search UniProt taxonomy. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search keywords in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/keywords.md): In Duaer, search UniProt keywords. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search locations in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/locations.md): In Duaer, search UniProt subcellular locations. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search Gene Ontology in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/gene-ontology.md): In Duaer, search Gene Ontology terms. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search pathways in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/pathways.md): In Duaer, search Reactome pathways. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search genes in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/genes.md): In Duaer, search genes. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search variants in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/variants.md): In Duaer, search variants (ClinVar / dbSNP). One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search domains in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/domains.md): In Duaer, search InterPro domains. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search preprints in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/preprints.md): In Duaer, search bioRxiv and medRxiv preprints via Europe PMC. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search grants in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/grants.md): In Duaer, search NIH grants via RePORTER. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search interactions in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/interactions.md): In Duaer, search STRING protein interaction partners. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search expression in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/expression.md): In Duaer, search GTEx median tissue expression. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search targets in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/targets.md): In Duaer, search Open Targets gene–disease associations. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search orthologs in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/orthologs.md): In Duaer, search cross-species orthologs (MyGene HomoloGene). One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search activities in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/activities.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL bioactivities by molecule or target. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search tissue atlas in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/atlas.md): In Duaer, search Human Protein Atlas tissue-enriched expression. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search indications in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/indications.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL drug indications by molecule. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search mechanisms in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/mechanisms.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL mechanisms of action by molecule. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search GEO in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/geo.md): In Duaer, search NCBI GEO series and datasets. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search assays in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/assays.md): In Duaer, search ChEMBL assays by words or assay id. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search patents in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/patents.md): In Duaer, search patents via Europe PMC. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Look up AlphaFold structures in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/alphafold.md): In Duaer, look up AlphaFold predicted structures by gene or UniProt accession. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search cell lines in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/cell-lines.md): In Duaer, search cell lines via Cellosaurus. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search drug–gene interactions in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/drug-gene.md): In Duaer, search drug–gene interactions via DGIdb. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search reactions in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/reactions.md): In Duaer, search biochemical reactions via Rhea. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search complexes in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/complexes.md): In Duaer, search protein complexes via Complex Portal. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search metabolites in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/metabolites.md): In Duaer, search metabolites via ChEBI. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search drug labels in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/drug-labels.md): In Duaer, search FDA drug labels via OpenFDA. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search adverse events in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/adverse-events.md): In Duaer, search FDA adverse event reports via OpenFDA FAERS. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search GWAS associations in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/gwas.md): In Duaer, search GWAS Catalog associations via REST API v2. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search RxNorm in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/rxnorm.md): In Duaer, look up drug names via RxNorm (NLM RxNav). One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search MeSH in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/mesh.md): In Duaer, look up MeSH subject headings (NLM MeSH). One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search phenotypes in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/phenotypes.md): In Duaer, look up HPO phenotype terms (EBI OLS). One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search crossrefs in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/crossrefs.md): In Duaer, look up UniChem compound cross-references by InChIKey. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search drug recalls in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/drug-recalls.md): In Duaer, search FDA drug recall enforcement reports via OpenFDA. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search ligands in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/ligands.md): In Duaer, look up PDBe chemical component (CCD) ligands. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search ChEMBL in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/chembl.md): In Duaer, search bioactive molecules via ChEMBL. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search Ensembl in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/ensembl.md): In Duaer, look up Ensembl genes by symbol or id. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search KEGG in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/kegg.md): In Duaer, search KEGG pathways, diseases, or compounds. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search Monarch in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/monarch.md): In Duaer, search Monarch diseases, phenotypes, or genes. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search HGNC in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/hgnc.md): In Duaer, look up approved gene symbols via HGNC. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search PRIDE in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/pride.md): In Duaer, search proteomics projects in PRIDE. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search Uberon in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/uberon.md): In Duaer, search anatomy terms via Uberon. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search BioStudies in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/biostudies.md): In Duaer, search multi-omics studies in BioStudies. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search Orphanet in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/orphanet.md): In Duaer, search rare diseases via Orphanet. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Search EFO in Duaer](https://skills.duaer.com/efo.md): In Duaer, search experimental factors via EFO. One successful search uses 1 credit.
- [Get a Duaer key](https://skills.duaer.com/keys.md): A Duaer key authorizes calls to the Duaer data API. Create it after you sign in. The full value is shown once.
